Link an existing Patient to a Facility. Safe to call more than once.

LLM-routed natural-language analytics query, with a deterministic fallback
post.description: An LLM selects which approved analytics tools apply to the question and writes a narrative answer grounded in their actual output. Falls back to English-keyword tool routing and a templated summary if the LLM is unavailable/unconfigured. No cross-turn follow-up/pronoun resolution yet. See the response's `capability_level` and `supported_languages` fields for which path this response used.

ClinicalDraftEditRequest.title: ClinicalDraftEditRequest
ClinicalDraftEditRequest.description:
Fields left unset (absent from the request JSON) are carried forward
unchanged from `source_draft_id`'s current values — this is a merge, not
a full replace. To intentionally clear a section, send it explicitly as
an empty list/all-false object rather than omitting it.

ai_summary.description: AI-synthesized ~10-second briefing over the fields above — never a substitute for them. Null if summary generation failed or is unconfigured.

ConsultationWorkspaceResponse.title: ConsultationWorkspaceResponse
ConsultationWorkspaceResponse.description:
Everything a clinical workspace needs to reload after a browser
refresh, logout/login, or network interruption — the current
Consultation, its latest transcript/draft/STT job, and the prescription
and lab orders attached to it, in one call.

capability_level.title: Capability Level
capability_level.description: 'llm': an LLM chose the tools and wrote the narrative answer. 'deterministic': the LLM was unavailable/unconfigured and this response used the English-keyword-to-tool fallback with a templated metric summary instead. There is no follow-up/pronoun resolution across turns in either case.

supported_languages.title: Supported Languages
supported_languages.description: ['en', 'ur'] when capability_level is 'llm'; ['en'] when it fell back to the keyword matcher.

degradation_reason.title: Degradation Reason
degradation_reason.description: Why capability_level is deterministic for an LLM-capable path. llm_not_configured means the provider endpoint/key is absent; llm_provider_error means a configured provider failed or returned invalid output.

health signal, not a business metric: a growing pending/retry count
means background processing (STT jobs, notifications, ...) is falling
behind across the whole platform, not just one tenant.
